data.title: 莉雅丝 · 商业街午后的甜蜜可丽饼
data.description: 【莉雅丝 · 商业街午后的甜蜜可丽饼】繁华步行街的露天遮阳伞下，微风卷起路旁的樱花花瓣。莉雅丝穿着合身的驹王学园制服，双手捧着刚买的草莓奶油可丽饼，微红着脸颊将最顶端的新鲜草莓递向你的唇边，水蓝色的眼眸里满是期待——「啊——张嘴。听说这家店在人类情侣里很受欢迎，味道真的不错呢。」
data.location: 洒满落樱的商业步行街遮阳伞长椅
data.action: 坐在长椅上微倾身子，双手捧着草莓可丽饼向视角前方喂食，脸颊泛着淡淡红晕
data.lighting: 明亮通透的自然阳光与落樱微影
data.camera: medium shot, slightly high angle, close perspective
data.promptProse: Beneath the shopping street's outdoor parasol, Rias Gremory offers the top strawberry of her cream-filled crepe toward her companion. Her Kuoh blouse, black vest and magenta cross tie remain visible as she leans forward, blue eyes expectant. Frame her from a slightly high medium angle, with cafe tables and cherry branches behind. Afternoon daylight brightens strawberry seeds and white cuffs; petals cast small moving shadows along the tabletop.
